note: Backend acceptance traceability for every SSOT acceptance/invariant rule. Status: covered (named tests assert the backend behaviour), partial (gap stated), client_only, owner_blocked (open owner/calibration decision), uncovered. Classified 2026-09-25 by four independent read-only audits, then re-checked after the gap-closing tests; scripts/tracker_traceability.py verifies every cited test exists.

rules.rule: **No opaque judgment.** V1 MUST NOT present an overall match score, letter grade, composite performance score, player rating, percentile, arbitrary good/bad-player judgment, or opaque AI verdict.
rules.note: Checked-in mobile OpenAPI has no score/grade/rating/percentile/rank/verdict/composite/win-rate fields; Progress/MatchDetail field sets asserted.

rules.rule: **No fabricated certainty.** Missing, malformed, unavailable, or insufficient evidence MUST be represented as N/A, an explicit unavailable state, or an explicit ineligible reason. It MUST NOT be silently converted to zero or to a synthetic comparison.
rules.note: Missing/malformed evidence stays None with reasons; malformed history raises; missing baseline is BASELINE_BUILDING; ineligibility carries explicit reasons.

rules.rule: **N/A is not zero.** A legitimate measured zero remains zero. These are different states and MUST be distinguishable everywhere they appear.
rules.note: Measured 0 vs None distinct in metrics, DB rows, and golden mobile payload (MEASURED raw_value 0 beside NOT_AVAILABLE with reason).

rules.rule: **Standard and Turbo are separate progression worlds.** They MAY use identical methodology, but MUST NOT share baselines, trends, Personal Bests, observations, queues, blockers, or progression histories.
rules.note: Unresolved Standard work never blocks Turbo; Turbo PB rows never mix with Standard.

rules.rule: **Progression is role-specific.** Every successfully classified retained match resolves to exactly one of Carry, Mid, Offlane, Support. Position 4 and Position 5 both map to Support. There is no Unknown progression role.
rules.note: Positions 4/5 map to SUPPORT; unclassified role yields ROLE_UNAVAILABLE not progression; role/metric mismatch rejected.

rules.rule: **Historical comparisons are time-relative.** A historical match compares against the same-role, same-mode baseline that existed *before* that match. A later match MUST NOT make an old comparison silently drift.
rules.note: Priors strictly before match; golden pins per-match frozen baseline_snapshot (prior_count differs per historical match).

rules.rule: **Canonical methodology is singular.** One methodology at a time. Approved migrations rebuild compatible retained history deterministically; old and new math never coexist in one canonical timeline.
rules.note: Methodology change rebuilds closure deterministically/idempotently; prior selection filters by analysis_version so versions never mix.

rules.rule: **Current truth and past events are distinct.** Derived current truth (PBs, baselines, trends, comparisons) MAY be rebuilt. Delivered celebrations and notifications are append-only, auditable, and are never retracted or replayed.
rules.note: Rebuilds/corrections leave event counts unchanged (no retraction/replay); delivery outcomes never touch events.

rules.rule: **Subscription does not change measurement truth.** Free and Pro use identical processing and methodology for whatever history each tier is entitled to inspect. Pro adds depth, synthesis and engagement — never better accuracy.
rules.note: Acquisition/analysis never read scope; returning to Free reuses the identical analysis row.

rules.rule: **Account isolation is absolute.** Cursors, match entries, role assertions, histories, derived state, acknowledgements and notifications are scoped to the app account and the active Steam profile.
rules.note: Cross-account match/history/role/retry reads 404; profile switch isolates; deletion removes private state.

rules.rule: **No teammate attribution.** V1 MUST NOT estimate, score, label, or imply teammate quality, and MUST NOT attach any coefficient, adjustment or copy to a teammate's behaviour or hero.
rules.note: Context inputs allowlisted (no outcome/teammate behaviour); insight copy has no causal or teammate claims.

rules.rule: **No causal explanation of the match result.** No surface may claim why a match was won or lost.
rules.note: Context inputs allowlisted (no outcome/teammate behaviour); insight copy has no causal or teammate claims.

rules.rule: **Implementation status is not product status.** A locked contract is not shipped merely because it is documented.
rules.note: Governance/documentation rule; no runtime backend behaviour to test.

rules.rule: Standard history never changes a Turbo baseline, trend, PB, queue or history, and vice versa.
rules.note: Unresolved Standard work never blocks Turbo; Turbo PB rows never mix with Standard.

rules.rule: Every successfully classified retained match has exactly one effective role; P4/P5 are Support.
rules.note: Exactly one role per slot, P4/P5 -> SUPPORT, links get effective role; missing role is not a progression role.

rules.rule: A classifier rerun never overwrites the latest explicit user role assertion.
rules.note: Relinking and replay refinement keep the latest user assertion (MID, revision) intact.

rules.rule: Processing never waits for role confirmation; low-confidence prompting is corrective only.
rules.note: Low-confidence roles are used immediately; finalization reaches READY with no role assertion. Prompting itself is client UI.

rules.rule: Every retained match with sufficient telemetry exposes Edit Role.
rules.note: correction_available true with retained source (incl. ineligible matches), false and fail-closed when lineage missing.

rules.rule: A role correction rebuilds only the same-bucket old/new-role dependency closure, deterministically and idempotently, with no provider calls.
rules.note: Unaffected role and Turbo pointers unchanged; repeat is no-op; no provider calls during mobile role edit.

rules.rule: Discovery records all items before advancing its cursor and resumes without gaps or duplicate effects.
rules.note: Items journaled with outcomes atomically with cursor; rollback reuses stored page without refetch; duplicates cannot resend.

rules.rule: A later same-bucket match cannot finalize ahead of an older unresolved predecessor; the other bucket is never blocked.
rules.note: Same-bucket ordering wait plus explicit other-bucket progress.

rules.rule: READY has no partial variant and may coexist with N/A metrics or `NONE(reason)`.
rules.note: READY with N/A metrics and READY with progression NONE; lifecycle check constraint rejects non-enumerated states.

rules.rule: A provider/source failure is never relabelled as progression ineligibility to obtain READY.
rules.note: Missing role evidence yields UNAVAILABLE (not READY/NONE); disputed source keeps progression STANDARD. See onboarding#15.11 caveat on SUMMARY_404.

rules.rule: A match is openable and shows its factual record from `SUMMARY_READY`, without waiting for replay-derived analysis.
rules.note: Pre-finalization match returns 200 with facts AVAILABLE, performance PENDING, 10 players and role.

rules.rule: Exactly one finalization point exists per match; no comparison, performance state, PB event, progression observation or insight card is produced before it.
rules.note: Duplicate finalize is ALREADY_READY with unchanged counts; no analysis/metrics before FINALIZE; exactly one completed FINALIZE job.

rules.rule: A `REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE` match reaches READY with its replay-class metrics as N/A, and is never shown as `UNAVAILABLE` or `ACTION_REQUIRED`.
rules.note: REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE finalizes READY with reasoned N/A replay metrics; replay exhaustion never sets ACTION_REQUIRED.

rules.rule: No replay-dependent surface renders an endless spinner; every pending deep section has a terminal outcome.
rules.note: Replay wait is bounded by checks and elapsed limit, ending terminal REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE then READY. Spinner rendering is client.

rules.rule: Advancing readiness adds deep content; it never replaces or invalidates Stage-1 content already on screen.
rules.note: Replay enrichment preserves summary header/summary_ready_at and immutable old inputs; Stage-1 facts persist into READY.

rules.rule: No product copy anywhere contains a provider name or pipeline vocabulary.
rules.note: Backend payloads/OpenAPI scanned for provider/pipeline vocabulary. Enum codes like REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE remain; client copy mapping untestable here.

rules.rule: The classifier produces an effective role from summary-class evidence alone; no fresh match waits on a provider's native role label.
rules.note: Classifier ignores native position/role fields and assigns effective role from summary farm before replay.

rules.rule: A classifier rerun before finalization writes no history, emits no notification, and is not treated as a correction.
rules.note: Pre-finalization rerun writes no assertion, event or analysis.

rules.rule: Free and Pro share one ingestion pipeline and one match model; entitlement is applied above persisted analysis results.
rules.note: Scope tokens absent below entitlement; Free and Pro users share one match row and one replay job.

rules.rule: Automatic retries are bounded; manual Retry resumes the earliest unresolved stage without duplicating the match or its effects.
rules.note: Bounded attempts -> FAILED; retry reopens earliest failed stage, single job, one analysis, no provider calls, idempotent.

rules.rule: A historical Match Detail never silently compares against today's baseline.
rules.note: Match detail reads frozen per-analysis baseline_snapshot; golden pins distinct prior_count per historical match.

rules.rule: A missing baseline produces an explicit baseline-building state, never a synthetic comparison.
rules.note: Fewer than 5 priors -> BASELINE_BUILDING, performance NOT_READY; golden shows BUILDING with null baseline_value.

rules.rule: A READY but ineligible match remains viewable, states that it does not count, and gives the reason.
rules.note: Golden: READY match with progression NONE and progression_reason SHORT_OR_INVALID_DURATION served 200.

rules.rule: Baseline is the previous-20 **median** after a 5-prior gate; trend needs a complete 10-point window.
rules.note: Median of last 20 after 5-prior gate; trend INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY below 10 measured points. Thresholds uncalibrated (owner).

rules.rule: No time decay, inactivity reset, Progress-specific retention cutoff, composite role trend, or overall progress score exists.
rules.note: Per-metric readiness differs within a role; a 200-day gap changes nothing; invalid metric rejected; unplayed role empty.

rules.rule: A current PB always points to its qualifying source match under the current entitlement and methodology; ties are not PBs.
rules.note: Ties keep earliest owner (not new PB); priors filtered by scope and analysis_version; PB exposes source match_ref.

rules.rule: PB comparison uses the comparison value and all known eligible history, not the 20-observation window.
rules.note: PB found at match 1 outside the 20-observation baseline window.

rules.rule: Imports, backfills, recovery, entitlement changes and rebuilds never generate retroactive celebrations or notification spam.
rules.note: Import beating the record, scope rebuilds and late re-admission create no events or outbox rows.

rules.rule: Context adjustment reads no realised in-match behaviour, no teammate hero, and no outcome.
rules.note: ContextInput has no outcome/telemetry slot; changing a teammate hero leaves lane score unchanged.

rules.rule: Lane context never appears in the same claim as the match result, and never softens a BELOW state.
rules.note: Lane context never alters the performance label (difficult lane still BELOW); insight copy excludes lane context.

rules.rule: `UNAVAILABLE` lane context renders nothing and is never drawn as `Typical`.
rules.note: Backend emits distinct UNAVAILABLE (never TYPICAL) on gaps/missing parameters; rendering nothing is client.

rules.rule: `offlane.objective_involvement.v1` emits no performance state.
rules.note: Class E objective_involvement evaluates NOT_READY despite measured value above baseline; mobile_api nulls it (untested at API level).

rules.rule: A metric whose baseline median sits at its floor receives no population adjustment.
rules.note: Baseline at floor (0.0) yields zero hero and lane deltas.

rules.rule: Notification permission or device state never gates processing, readiness, progression or account state.
rules.note: READY event recorded without permission/device; revocation only suppresses push; finalization reaches READY with notifications disabled.

rules.rule: No surface introduces a score, grade, composite judgment, causal result explanation, teammate claim, or opaque AI verdict.
rules.note: No verdict fields in the contract; insight copy scanned for causal and teammate-judgement wording.

rules.rule: Every retained match is visible, including ineligible, failed and unavailable matches.
rules.note: Unfiltered history lists ready, processing, unsupported-mode and late-admitted matches; each opens Match Detail.

rules.rule: History renders from persisted records; no History interaction triggers a provider call.
rules.note: Every mobile GET incl. /history run with network I/O refused; read-path modules import no provider clients; seed reads leave provider_calls empty.

rules.rule: A match appears once summary-class evidence exists, and never disappears because deep analysis is pending or permanently unavailable.
rules.note: WAITING_FOR_PROVIDER link listed in /history with facts AVAILABLE; golden match_states lists pending and replay-unavailable READY rows.

rules.rule: Row navigation into Match Detail is valid at every readiness.
rules.note: For every persona, each /history ref opens /matches/{ref} with 200; golden covers READY, UNAVAILABLE, waiting, ACTION_REQUIRED.

rules.rule: History is never a provider-status dashboard: no provider names, no pipeline vocabulary, no progress bars, ETAs, retry counts or queue positions.
rules.note: Golden payloads and OpenAPI scanned for provider/pipeline vocabulary; closed schema has no progress/ETA/retry-count/queue fields. Bars are client.

rules.rule: Ordering is by canonical chronology; late-recovered matches are inserted at their true position.
rules.note: Rows sorted by canonical start time; a later-admitted older match lands at its position.

rules.rule: Each entry carries its own mode; no progression calculation crosses buckets or roles.
rules.note: Baseline excludes Turbo/other-role rows; correction leaves Turbo and other-role series untouched; rows carry mode (golden).

rules.rule: A History row never becomes a miniature Match Detail.
rules.note: Rows use the HistoryRow identity model; field set asserted exactly.

rules.rule: No composite progression curve, score, grade, rating or percentage appears in History.
rules.note: Checked-in mobile OpenAPI has no score/grade/rating/percentile/rank/verdict/composite/win-rate fields; Progress/MatchDetail field sets asserted.

rules.rule: Win/loss is never presented as progression.
rules.note: Win/loss framing is presentation; backend exposes plain won boolean.

rules.rule: Filters never redefine canonical baseline, trend or PB math.
rules.note: Filtered rows are identical to unfiltered ones; empty filter differs from empty account (/bootstrap).

rules.rule: History has no retention cutoff of its own.
rules.note: No date/retention filter exists in the pinned contract; every retained match is listed.

rules.rule: Entitlement limits are presented as scope, never as loss or performance.
rules.note: Scope wording is copy; backend scope-gating evidenced under history#11.13.

rules.rule: N/A is never rendered as zero; an unready state is never rendered as a neutral value.
rules.note: N/A: raw None iff reason; zero distinct from missing; golden asserts reasoned NOT_AVAILABLE and measured 0; unready rows performance PENDING.

rules.rule: Role correction does not happen here.
rules.note: Edit Role placement is UI; correction route lives under /matches/{ref}/role.

rules.rule: No causal explanation of any result appears here.
rules.note: Causal copy is presentation; backend emits template ids/slots only.

rules.rule: A match finished minutes ago is listed and openable before its deep analysis exists.
rules.note: Link at WAITING_FOR_PROVIDER listed in /history and opens with facts AVAILABLE, performance PENDING, 10 players.

rules.rule: A row with pending deep analysis does not disappear when the user refreshes, filters or returns later.
rules.note: Processing row remains listed under mode and role filters and across pages.

rules.rule: A row whose deep analysis is permanently unavailable is not marked as failed and carries no warning.
rules.note: Replay-unavailable finalizes to READY (not ACTION_REQUIRED/UNAVAILABLE); golden history row READY. Warning styling is client.

rules.rule: No row shows a progress bar, percentage, ETA, retry count, queue position, provider name or pipeline term.
rules.note: Vocabulary regex over all golden payloads and OpenAPI; schema has no progress, ETA, retry-count or queue fields.

rules.rule: Ineligible, processing, action-required and unavailable matches are all listed and openable.
rules.note: Ineligible, processing and failed matches are listed and open Match Detail.

rules.rule: A recovered historical match appears at its true chronological position, not at the end.
rules.note: Late-admitted older match appears at its chronological position in /history.

rules.rule: Every row shows its mode; no aggregate mixes Standard and Turbo.
rules.note: Rows carry mode (golden); baselines isolate buckets; rebuild leaves Turbo series untouched.

rules.rule: No row exposes per-metric performance state, matchup context, or insight content.
rules.note: Row field set excludes metrics, performance, lane context and insight content.

rules.rule: An ineligible row states that it does not count and gives the reason.
rules.note: Golden history row: progression NONE with progression_reason SHORT_OR_INVALID_DURATION; eligibility reasons unit-tested.

rules.rule: A calendar or mode filter changes what is listed without changing any canonical calculation.
rules.note: Filtered rows are identical to unfiltered ones; empty filter differs from empty account (/bootstrap).

rules.rule: Empty-account, unlinked and empty-filter states are visually and semantically distinct.
rules.note: Filtered rows are identical to unfiltered ones; empty filter differs from empty account (/bootstrap).

rules.rule: Offline/sync-error preserves the full known history and never claims emptiness.
rules.note: sync_error persona golden: readiness SYNC_ERROR while /history still returns cached READY row. Offline is client-side.

rules.rule: A reduced entitlement removes matches from view without implying data loss or decline.
rules.note: HISTORICAL row 404 under FREE, 200 again under PRO (data retained); pro_expired golden lists fewer rows. Wording is client.

rules.rule: After a role correction, the corrected row shows the new role and affected aggregates recompute within that bucket only.
rules.note: Detail shows new role after edit; rebuild touches same-bucket old/new-role series only, Turbo and other roles untouched.

rules.rule: Home's V1 content set is exactly the four elements in §2.
rules.note: HomeView holds exactly Focus/Today, Challenge, role summaries and Last 5 (pinned schema).

rules.rule: Today's Focus and Today's Matches never appear together.
rules.note: Backend returns both fields; choosing one for element 1 is UI.

rules.rule: Home never shows a composite role trend, role score, player score, grade, rating or percentage.
rules.note: HomeView/ProgressView carry no composite score, grade or percentage; absence pinned by exact golden payloads and checked-in OpenAPI.

rules.rule: Home never merges Standard and Turbo inside a progression calculation.
rules.note: Baseline excludes TURBO rows from STANDARD calc; bucket chronology isolated. /progress filters progression==mode. Home itself has no progression calc.

rules.rule: Home never reproduces Match Detail's per-metric analysis, matchup context, or insight card content.
rules.note: Golden Home payloads pin MatchSummary to ref/mode/time/lifecycle/role/hero/won; no metrics, matchup or insight fields.

rules.rule: Home never presents win/loss as personal performance.
rules.note: Backend exposes raw `won`; framing as performance is presentation.

rules.rule: Home never explains why a match was won or lost.
rules.note: Backend emits no explanation text; copy is client-side.

rules.rule: Home never fills the Today's Focus or Challenge slot with fabricated content.
rules.note: Asserts focus and challenge are {UNAVAILABLE, NOT_CONTRACTED}; golden pins this for every persona.

rules.rule: Home never renders N/A as zero, or an unready state as a neutral value.
rules.note: Golden asserts NOT_AVAILABLE distinct from MEASURED 0; non-READY lifecycles pinned on Home; trend <10 points is INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY. Rendering is client.

rules.rule: Home is usable from cache on every open, before discovery completes.
rules.note: /home served from stored state, provider-free, 200 for bootstrap-SEARCHING persona. Device-side caching itself is client.

rules.rule: Home never blocks on provider availability.
rules.note: All GET reads (incl. /home) succeed with every real network transport patched to raise.

rules.rule: Home acknowledges a completed match as soon as summary-class evidence exists, and never waits for deep analysis to do so.
rules.note: A summary-ready, analysis-pending match is in Today's Matches and Last 5 and opens Match Detail.

rules.rule: Home never withholds navigation into Match Detail because deep analysis is pending.
rules.note: Home entry ref opens /matches/{ref} with 200, facts AVAILABLE, performance PENDING before deep analysis.

rules.rule: Home never names a data provider or uses pipeline vocabulary.
rules.note: FORBIDDEN provider/pipeline regex scanned over all Home payloads and OpenAPI. Client copy out of scope.

rules.rule: Home never presents a pending or permanently unavailable deep analysis as an error, a warning or a failed match.
rules.note: Backend returns neutral lifecycle enums with 200; error/warning framing is UI.

rules.rule: Home renders usable cached state before discovery completes.
rules.note: /home returns 200 from store during unsettled bootstrap without provider I/O; on-device cache rendering is client.

rules.rule: A match finished minutes ago appears in Today's Matches before its deep analysis exists, and is openable.
rules.note: Today's pending match listed before deep analysis; rows open Match Detail.

rules.rule: Home reflects the finalized state once analysis persists, without the user re-triggering anything.
rules.note: Home re-read after finalization shows the same entry READY without a re-trigger.

rules.rule: An acknowledged match never disappears or regresses as readiness advances.
rules.note: A today entry keeps its ref and position and updates in place from WAITING_FOR_DATA to READY.

rules.rule: No Home string names a provider or uses pipeline vocabulary.
rules.note: Regex forbids provider/pipeline vocabulary in every captured Home payload and OpenAPI.

rules.rule: Element 1 shows Today's Matches when today has matches, otherwise Today's Focus — never both.
rules.note: Backend supplies today_matches and focus; element-1 mode selection is UI.

rules.rule: A single today's match may route straight to Match Detail; multiple route to History.
rules.note: Routing from Home is client navigation.

rules.rule: Role summaries exist for all four roles, scoped to one unambiguous bucket, with no composite verdict.
rules.note: Four role summaries for the selected bucket, metric-named states only, no composite field.

rules.rule: A role with insufficient trend history shows `Insufficient History`, never a flat or declining state.
rules.note: Fewer than 10 points yields INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY (golden /progress too); >=10 uncalibrated returns null+reason, not flat.

rules.rule: Last 5 Matches includes ineligible and non-READY matches, each carrying its mode.
rules.note: Last 5 spans both buckets, includes ineligible and non-READY entries, each with its mode.

rules.rule: No Home element reproduces per-metric performance states, matchup context, or insight card content.
rules.note: Golden Home payloads contain no per-metric state, matchup or insight fields.

rules.rule: `NO_STEAM_LINKED`, bootstrap-unsettled, sync-error and offline states are all representable without implying an empty account.
rules.note: Golden pins NO_STEAM_LINKED, SEARCHING bootstrap, SYNC_ERROR readiness with cached last_matches. Offline is client-only.

rules.rule: The Challenge slot degrades cleanly when the feature is absent.
rules.note: Challenge slot always {UNAVAILABLE, NOT_CONTRACTED} without breaking Home payload.

rules.rule: Today's Focus renders an honest neutral state rather than fabricated content when nothing qualifies.
rules.note: Focus slot returns honest {UNAVAILABLE, NOT_CONTRACTED}; content model itself is owner-blocked.

rules.rule: The match is openable and its factual record renders from `SUMMARY_READY`; Stage 1 never waits for replay-derived evidence.
rules.note: Summary-only link opens: facts AVAILABLE, 10 players, performance PENDING, metrics empty before replay/finalization.

rules.rule: Comparisons, performance states, matchup context, PB determination and insight cards appear only at the single finalization point.
rules.note: Metrics empty and insights PENDING before finalization; single analysis/insight/event published once at READY.

rules.rule: Advancing readiness adds deep sections; it never replaces or invalidates Stage-1 content.
rules.note: Stage-1 players, timing and result identical before and after READY.

rules.rule: No replay-dependent section renders an endless spinner; every pending section has a terminal outcome.
rules.note: Failed matches report terminal UNAVAILABLE blocks; only in-flight matches are PENDING.

rules.rule: A permanently unavailable deep section is a settled fact stated once — never an error, an apology or a retry prompt.
rules.note: Retry on a READY replay-unavailable match returns 409 RETRY_NOT_AVAILABLE.

rules.rule: A missing replay-derived metric is N/A with a reason, never zero and never estimated.
rules.note: Missing replay metrics carry reason with null raw; no interpolation at checkpoints; missing streams not zero.

rules.rule: No provider name or pipeline vocabulary appears in any product copy on this surface.
rules.note: All golden /matches payloads and OpenAPI scanned for provider/pipeline vocabulary. Product copy strings are client.

rules.rule: Personal performance and match diagnosis are never merged into one judgment.
rules.note: Separate metrics and insights structures; merging into one judgment is presentation.

rules.rule: Insight cards never read lane context, adjustments or the adjusted expectation.
rules.note: Insight cards are byte-identical before and after a context parameter-set rebuild.

rules.rule: At most 3 cards; slots are never filled; 0 cards is the majority, expected state.
rules.note: Selection caps at 3 without padding; single-card results stay single; EVALUATED with [] is valid.

rules.rule: Cards claim sequence, never cause.
rules.note: Sequence vs cause is template copy; backend emits template_id and slots.

rules.rule: History wording always states N and never exceeds its sample gate.
rules.note: No history line below the sample gate; lines state N; the API now carries history_line.

rules.rule: One matchup badge per match, on the lane-metric group; `UNAVAILABLE` renders nothing.
rules.note: B hero-only, C/C* hero+lane, D/A unadjusted; one lane label only for Standard cores; UNAVAILABLE otherwise.

rules.rule: A below-expectation state is never softened by matchup context.
rules.note: Performance enum has no softened value; badge rendering is presentation.

rules.rule: The matchup label and the match result never appear in the same claim.
rules.note: Claim copy is client; context inputs already exclude match outcome.

rules.rule: Comparisons use the baseline at the time, never today's baseline.
rules.note: Baseline uses only strictly-prior matches, snapshotted per observation; late older match does not rewrite newer window.

rules.rule: N/A is never rendered as zero.
rules.note: raw None iff unavailable_reason; golden asserts NOT_AVAILABLE with reason and separate measured zero.

rules.rule: `objective_involvement` emits no performance state.
rules.note: Objective involvement is diagnostic_only with no performance state in the API.

rules.rule: Trend states do not appear on this surface.
rules.note: Checked-in mobile OpenAPI has no score/grade/rating/percentile/rank/verdict/composite/win-rate fields; Progress/MatchDetail field sets asserted.

rules.rule: Edit Role is available on every retained match with sufficient telemetry.
rules.note: Correction available on older and newer READY matches from retained evidence, independent of confidence.

rules.rule: A correction rebuilds this match's metrics, comparisons, adjustments, PB state and insight result, deterministically, with no provider calls.
rules.note: Correction re-measures under the new role with recomputed context terms and parameter-set stamp; idempotent, provider-free.

rules.rule: A READY but ineligible match is visible, says it doesn't count, and gives the reason.
rules.note: Golden READY ineligible match: progression NONE, reason SHORT_OR_INVALID_DURATION, openable; ambiguous integrity yields progression NONE.

rules.rule: No score, grade, causal result explanation, teammate claim or visibility claim appears.
rules.note: No verdict fields in the contract; insight copy scanned for causal and teammate-judgement wording.

rules.rule: A match that just finished is openable and shows its full factual record before any replay-derived analysis exists.
rules.note: Summary-ready match opens with full factual roster (10 players) before replay; metrics empty.

rules.rule: No Stage-1 element becomes unavailable, greyed out, or framed as incomplete because deep sections are pending.
rules.note: facts AVAILABLE and 10 players for every lifecycle incl. pending (golden). Greying is client.

rules.rule: Deep sections pending shows a bounded affordance, never an endless spinner.
rules.note: Pending sections exist only for in-flight lifecycles; failures are terminal.

rules.rule: Readiness advancing while the screen is open adds sections without replacing Stage-1 content, and replays no celebration.
rules.note: Stage-1 players, timing and result identical before and after READY.

rules.rule: A match whose replay will never arrive reaches READY, states that once, offers no Retry, and shows N/A — not zero — for its replay-derived metrics.
rules.note: Retry on a READY replay-unavailable match returns 409 RETRY_NOT_AVAILABLE.

rules.rule: Such a match renders the normal no-insight-card state, not an error.
rules.note: Replay-unavailable eligible match returns the normal AVAILABLE zero-card insight state.

rules.rule: No string on this surface names a provider or uses pipeline vocabulary.
rules.note: Vocabulary regex over every golden /matches payload and OpenAPI schema.

rules.rule: Every applicable metric shows a value, a legitimate zero, or an explicit N/A with a reason.
rules.note: Metric rows are MEASURED (incl. legit 0) or NOT_AVAILABLE with non-null reason.

rules.rule: A metric without a ready baseline shows baseline-not-established, never a synthetic comparison.
rules.note: Under 5 priors BASELINE_BUILDING and NOT_READY; golden rows BUILDING with null baseline and no state.

rules.rule: Class A/D and Turbo metrics compare against "your usual"; class B/C/C\* Standard metrics compare against the adjusted expectation.
rules.note: B hero-only, C/C* hero+lane, D/A unadjusted; one lane label only for Standard cores; UNAVAILABLE otherwise.

rules.rule: `offlane.objective_involvement.v1` shows value + personal median only.
rules.note: Objective involvement is diagnostic_only with no performance state in the API.

rules.rule: Exactly one matchup badge appears, on the lane-metric group, for Standard cores only; `UNAVAILABLE` shows nothing.
rules.note: B hero-only, C/C* hero+lane, D/A unadjusted; one lane label only for Standard cores; UNAVAILABLE otherwise.

rules.rule: `DIFFICULT + BELOW` renders identically to `TYPICAL + BELOW`.
rules.note: Rendering equivalence is presentation; state enum independent of label.

rules.rule: No string contains both the matchup label and the match result.
rules.note: String composition is client; backend emits enums only.

rules.rule: A match with 0 insight cards renders a designed normal state, not an error or an empty container.
rules.note: EVALUATED with no cards is valid; projected insights AVAILABLE with cards []. Designed UI is client.

rules.rule: Cards render in engine order; no client reordering, merging or padding.
rules.note: Engine selection order tested; API pass-through order untested (no golden fixture has cards).

rules.rule: Every history claim states N and respects its sample gate.
rules.note: No history line below the sample gate; lines state N; the API now carries history_line.

rules.rule: Current PB ownership is distinguishable from the one-time NEW_PB event.
rules.note: Detail exposes current owns_personal_best separately from celebrated_personal_best.

rules.rule: Edit Role is present on old, recent, high-confidence and low-confidence matches alike.
rules.note: Correction available on older and newer READY matches from retained evidence, independent of confidence.

rules.rule: After a correction, the metric set, comparisons, adjustments, PB state and insight result all reflect the new role, with unsupported metrics as N/A.
rules.note: New role's metric set, context terms and reasoned N/A for unsupported metrics after correction.

rules.rule: A READY ineligible match is fully viewable with its reason and no comparisons.
rules.note: READY ineligible match shows reason, raw metrics and no baseline or performance comparison.

rules.rule: `ACTION_REQUIRED` exposes exactly one Retry; `UNAVAILABLE` remains manually retryable.
rules.note: ACTION_REQUIRED and UNAVAILABLE both manually retryable, idempotent, account-scoped. Single-button is UI.

rules.rule: `WAITING_FOR_PRIOR_MATCH` does not read as an error.
rules.note: Later same-bucket match sets WAITING_FOR_PRIOR_MATCH lifecycle, not a failure. Copy is client.

rules.rule: Authentication is required before Home; there is no guest mode.
rules.note: No-header request gets 401 problem+json; golden pins /home 401 for revoked session. Direct no-header /home not asserted.

rules.rule: Steam is optional for exploration, required for tracking, required before Pro purchase.
rules.note: Unlinked user: /home 200, /profile 409 STEAM_LINK_REQUIRED; purchase without Steam rejected; link enqueues bootstrap.

rules.rule: Bootstrap caps are 30 Standard **and** 30 Turbo, independent, within 90 days before the link date.
rules.note: 30 Standard / 7 Turbo selected independently; AFTER_LINK and BEFORE_WINDOW (>90d) rejected; refill per mode.

rules.rule: Standard and Turbo never satisfy one another's minimum-history requirements.
rules.note: Turbo rows excluded from Standard 5-prior gate; eligibility counts and refills are per mode.

rules.rule: Free History = bootstrap + all eligible post-link matches, permanently.
rules.note: Free priors = BOOTSTRAP + LIVE, HISTORICAL excluded; pre-link HISTORICAL match 404 on Free; revert to Free restores same state.

rules.rule: A live match during unsettled bootstrap appears immediately but defers history-dependent finalization for its own mode only.
rules.note: Live Standard match waits while Standard bootstrap is unsettled; Turbo finalizes.

rules.rule: Imports never produce per-match notifications, PBs, achievements, baseline-ready events or celebrations.
rules.note: Bootstrap-origin match that beats the record updates the PB silently, no NEW_PB or READY event.

rules.rule: There is exactly one idempotent bootstrap-completion event per Steam-profile bootstrap.
rules.note: settle_bootstrap called twice yields exactly one BOOTSTRAP_COMPLETED event, only after both modes terminal.

rules.rule: Notification permission is requested only at Home, with contextual value.
rules.note: Permission prompt timing is a client UI decision.

rules.rule: No role or goals questionnaire exists.
rules.note: Questionnaire is UI; pinned mobile OpenAPI exposes no role/goal preference input.

rules.rule: Temporary provider failure is never presented as a permanent empty-state conclusion.
rules.note: Failures never finish search or set coverage. Caveat: terminal SUMMARY_404 settles as NO_ELIGIBLE_MATCHES (test_terminal_summary_absence...).

rules.rule: The Free-history entitlement boundary is anchored to the original Steam-link date and never shifts forward.
rules.note: original_linked_at unchanged through blocked access and recovery; bootstrap window computed from original link.

rules.rule: Bootstrap acquires both summary-class and replay-class evidence; it is not a summary-only import.
rules.note: Bootstrap selections enqueue deep HISTORICAL_BATCH yielding REPLAY_READY; missing deep rows fall back to summary.

rules.rule: Replay-class coverage gaps in the bootstrap window are recorded as coverage gaps, never as matches not played.
rules.note: Replay-unavailable finalization records REPLAY coverage GAP; GAP in window yields READY_WITH_GAPS (gap row inserted manually).

rules.rule: A bootstrap match without replay-class evidence is a valid match with N/A replay metrics, never a failure.
rules.note: Bootstrap-origin replay-unavailable match is READY, progression-eligible, reasoned N/A.

rules.rule: Bootstrap acquisition is identical for Free and Pro; Pro extends depth, not mechanism.
rules.note: Free and Pro profiles produce identical bootstrap acquisition work.

rules.rule: Bootstrap never delays any user's newly completed match, including the bootstrapping user's own.
rules.note: Bootstrap work is P3; blocked P3 does not starve P0; live finalization ignores pending imports.

rules.rule: Metric-level baseline readiness may legitimately differ by evidence class, and is never explained to the user in backend terms.
rules.note: Baseline readiness per metric counts only measured priors; payload vocabulary scanned. User wording is client.

rules.rule: Value-proposition screens appear for brand-new users only and are never replayed.
rules.note: Value-proposition screen display is device/UI state.

rules.rule: No single `ONBOARDING_COMPLETE` flag conflates account, Steam, bootstrap and baseline readiness.
rules.note: Account (steam_linked), per-mode bootstrap outcomes and readiness are separate endpoints/fields; no ONBOARDING_COMPLETE in pinned schema.

rules.rule: A colliding auth identity is blocked, never merged.
rules.note: Attaching an identity owned by another user raises IdentityCollision with recovery route; owner session retained.

rules.rule: An authenticated user with no Steam can reach and navigate Home.
rules.note: Golden no_steam_linked persona: /home, /history, /settings return 200; bootstrap NO_STEAM_LINKED.

rules.rule: Bootstrap searches 30 Standard and 30 Turbo independently within 90 days.
rules.note: Independent 30-per-mode caps within 90-day pre-link window.

rules.rule: Bootstrap survives force quit, logout, restart and reinstall without duplicating or resetting.
rules.note: Session revocation and a new sign-in leave the server-owned bootstrap job and cursor intact.

rules.rule: Bootstrap is terminal only after both searches finish and every discovered match is processed or terminally failed.
rules.note: search_finished alone not terminal; waits for link terminal and non-pending coverage; event needs both modes.

rules.rule: All six product-level bootstrap outcomes are representable, per mode.
rules.note: All six outcomes observed per mode in golden; READY_WITH_GAPS, NO_MATCHES_FOUND, NO_ELIGIBLE, DATA_ACCESS_BLOCKED derived by settle_bootstrap.

rules.rule: Bootstrap attempts replay-class evidence, not only summary-class.
rules.note: Bootstrap selections go to deep historical batches (origin BOOTSTRAP) materializing REPLAY_READY.

rules.rule: A bootstrap match whose replay evidence is unobtainable is viewable, counted, and shows N/A — not zero — for its replay-derived metrics.
rules.note: Bootstrap-origin replay-unavailable match is READY, progression-eligible, reasoned N/A.

rules.rule: Replay-coverage gaps inside the bootstrap window produce `READY_WITH_GAPS`, not `NO_MATCHES_FOUND`.
rules.note: Replay GAP coverage in window with an eligible match yields READY_WITH_GAPS.

rules.rule: A Free and a Pro account bootstrap the same Free window by the same mechanism.
rules.note: Bootstrap work is byte-identical under Free and Pro scope.

rules.rule: A large bootstrap never delays a freshly completed match for any user.
rules.note: Real Celery P0 worker completes while P3 historical work is blocked.

rules.rule: A live match during unsettled bootstrap shows its facts and defers only its history-dependent state, for its own mode.
rules.note: Only the unsettled mode defers; the other bucket proceeds.

rules.rule: No per-match notification/PB/celebration is emitted for imported matches.
rules.note: Imported and re-admitted matches emit no per-match notification, PB or celebration.

rules.rule: Exactly one idempotent bootstrap-completion event exists, and it is not queued for later permission grants.
rules.note: One completion event; nothing queued in the push outbox for later permission.

rules.rule: Notification permission is never requested before Home.
rules.note: Permission prompt timing is client UI.

rules.rule: No role or goals questionnaire is presented.
rules.note: No questionnaire is a UI flow rule.

rules.rule: Data-access recovery re-anchors to the original Steam-link date and records unrecoverable gaps.
rules.note: Recovery anchored to the original link date queues post-link matches; absent sources are recorded as gaps.

rules.rule: First Pro activation waits for a coherent Free foundation and activates atomically.
rules.note: Scope stays FREE until bootstrap and history settle; single rebuild publishes PRO revision atomically.

rules.rule: The Profile concludes; it does not measure. It never re-derives a Progress number.
rules.note: Profile PB equals Progress PB; Standard and Turbo counts separate; GAP never shown as known history.

rules.rule: Every visible claim has receipts. No claim ships without a "Why?" panel.
rules.note: Claims withheld CALIBRATION_PENDING (§12). profile_claims evaluator validates evidence but is not wired into the projection.

rules.rule: Claims move slowly, with hysteresis and persistence. One match never changes identity.
rules.note: Tier hysteresis verified; claim persistence gap and enter/exit values are unset §12 parameters.

rules.rule: Refusal is a valid state. Below the gates, the Profile shows facts and an honest phrase — never a manufactured personality.
rules.note: Below 10: identity None; ≥10: unconfirmed 'so far' fallback, claims [] with CALIBRATION_PENDING; no default archetype.

rules.rule: No overall score, grade, rating, percentile, radar, or rank-derived label.
rules.note: Checked-in mobile OpenAPI has no score/grade/rating/percentile/rank/verdict/composite/win-rate fields; Progress/MatchDetail field sets asserted.

rules.rule: Specialist and Flexible are equal identities.
rules.note: Presentation parity of identity templates; also Role Shape withheld (§12).

rules.rule: Every aggregate is per bucket; only Mode-Split compares buckets, and it never pools their matches.
rules.note: Profile PB equals Progress PB; Standard and Turbo counts separate; GAP never shown as known history.

rules.rule: Hero tags are per bucket × role, never across either.
rules.note: Hero tags withheld (tags_state CALIBRATION_PENDING); tag cut points are §12 provisional parameters.

rules.rule: Favourite is player-pinned, never inferred, never analytic.
rules.note: Favourite set only via POST /profile/favourite-hero; golden personas with played heroes show favourite_hero_id null.

rules.rule: Matches without a resolved role are excluded from role claims and surfaced as a correction affordance.
rules.note: Unassigned matches excluded from role map and reported as unassigned_count.

rules.rule: Role Shape is withheld when more than 20% of the identity window lacks a role.
rules.note: More than 20% unassigned withholds Role Shape (role_shape_withheld=UNASSIGNED_ROLES).

rules.rule: Every Right-now item carries its window label.
rules.note: Right now withheld (right_now_state CALIBRATION_PENDING); form-run gate/windows are §12 parameters.

rules.rule: Down-runs are never first and never shared.
rules.note: Right now and its down-runs withheld pending §12 form-run calibration; share path has no Right-now kind.

rules.rule: Volume alone infers nothing. Volume is not a trait.
rules.note: Volume-driven inferences live in §12-calibrated claims, all withheld; no test pins header volume to non-inference.

rules.rule: Imported history never creates retroactive celebrations or change events.
rules.note: Import/scope rebuild adds no NEW_PB/MATCH_READY/other events; late BOOTSTRAP match emits no NEW_PB; celebrate=False suppresses.

rules.rule: No single-match analytics are copied onto the Profile.
rules.note: Checked-in mobile OpenAPI has no score/grade/rating/percentile/rank/verdict/composite/win-rate fields; Progress/MatchDetail field sets asserted.

rules.rule: No claim implies complete lifetime evidence when only part of its window is covered.
rules.note: Claims withheld (§12); evaluator coverage gate tested but unwired and coverage_complete is caller-supplied.

rules.rule: A claim whose window lacks the coverage it needs is withheld, never computed on a partial window and presented as whole.
rules.note: Evaluator withholds on incomplete coverage, but no production caller computes coverage; claims withheld pending §12.

rules.rule: Missing history is absent, never zero and never a low value.
rules.note: Profile PB equals Progress PB; Standard and Turbo counts separate; GAP never shown as known history.

rules.rule: Profile is computed from persisted features; no Profile interaction triggers a provider call or launches a backfill.
rules.note: All seeded Profile reads run with network transports disabled and enqueue no work.

rules.rule: Coverage is communicated in player terms, never in backend terms.
rules.note: Forbidden provider/pipeline vocabulary scan over all payloads; coverage exposed as earliest_known_at/more_arriving.

rules.rule: The identity line is composed only from confirmed Role Shape and Hero Shape states, or an honest "so far" fallback, or nothing.
rules.note: Only 'so far' fallbacks (MOSTLY_ROLE_SO_FAR / BIT_OF_EVERYTHING) or none below 10; confirmed lines await calibration.

rules.rule: Below 10 matches there is no identity line; below 30 the role map shows counts only.
rules.note: 7 matches → identity None; 12 matches → role_map counts with share/tier None.

rules.rule: Role Shape is withheld when over 20% of the identity window lacks a resolved role.
rules.note: Role Shape withheld above 20% unassigned.

rules.rule: Every visible claim can produce its evidence panel with window, n, thresholds and contributing matches.
rules.note: No visible claims (§12). Evaluator requires window/n/thresholds/sample ids; no evidence-panel endpoint exists.

rules.rule: A claim never appears before its persistence gap is satisfied, and never disappears without its exit condition.
rules.note: Lifecycle gap/exit tested in evaluator only; not wired; persistence gap value is §12 provisional.

rules.rule: A discarded candidate leaves no user-visible trace.
rules.note: Evaluator drops failed candidate; claims unwired pending §12, no user-visible surface to test.

rules.rule: At most three claims and at most two Right-now items are shown.
rules.note: Claims and Right now both withheld (CALIBRATION_PENDING); caps untestable until §12 calibration.

rules.rule: Every Right-now item carries a window label; down-runs are never first.
rules.note: Right now withheld pending §12 form-run calibration.

rules.rule: Hero tags are scoped to one bucket and one role; Favourite is only ever player-set.
rules.note: Hero-tag candidate floors and hysteresis are unset §12 parameters; tags are withheld (CALIBRATION_PENDING).

rules.rule: Mode-Split compares two buckets without pooling their matches; no other claim crosses buckets.
rules.note: Mode-Split claim withheld pending §12; per-bucket projection only implicitly pinned by golden.

rules.rule: No composite score, grade, rating, radar or percentile appears anywhere.
rules.note: Checked-in mobile OpenAPI has no score/grade/rating/percentile/rank/verdict/composite/win-rate fields; Progress/MatchDetail field sets asserted.

rules.rule: Specialist and Flexible are presented as equal identities.
rules.note: Presentation parity of identity templates; Role Shape also withheld (§12).

rules.rule: A role correction rebuilds Profile aggregates in that bucket and records a Change event where displayed state changed.
rules.note: Correction republishes the checkpoint; a change receipt requires a confirmed identity, which needs §12 claim parameters.

rules.rule: An import changes displayed state without creating celebrations or backdated change events.
rules.note: Settled import publishes one IMPORT checkpoint; importing buckets keep the prior one; no celebrations.

rules.rule: Profile stays usable on its existing coherent state throughout a running import, and never rewrites claims match by match.
rules.note: Importing bucket keeps prior checkpoint (not republished); Free state stays active until Pro rebuild publishes atomically.

rules.rule: Every visible claim's evidence panel states the sample it was actually computed over.
rules.note: Evaluator rejects n≠sample count; no visible claims or panel until §12 calibration.

rules.rule: A claim whose window lacks the required coverage is absent, not computed on what happens to be available.
rules.note: Evaluator withholds on coverage_complete=False; unwired, claims withheld pending §12.

rules.rule: Opening Profile, switching bucket or role, or opening an evidence panel triggers no provider call and no backfill.
rules.note: Profile reads (both buckets) make no provider call and queue no backfill.

rules.rule: Identity claims render for an account with summary-class history only; "Right now" is simply absent until replay-class coverage exists.
rules.note: Identity claims and Right now both withheld pending §12; summary-only vs replay coverage split untested.

rules.rule: The share card is built from the whitelisted projection only, and is unavailable without a confirmed identity line.
rules.note: Profile share refused without a confirmed identity (needs §12 calibration); PB share whitelist verified.

rules.rule: A private provider profile produces a refusal state, never fabricated content.
rules.note: Blocked account → profile state DATA_ACCESS_BLOCKED; golden shows identity null, claims/role_map/heroes empty.

rules.rule: A match contributes observations only at its single finalization point; no provisional or deep-dependent value is shown before its inputs exist.
rules.note: Stage-one metrics empty until finalization; single publish, retry ALREADY_READY; replay terminal alone does not finalize.

rules.rule: A metric whose inputs already exist is never delayed waiting for another metric's evidence.
rules.note: Summary metrics measured despite replay unavailable; eligibility independent of metric availability.

rules.rule: Metrics within one role legitimately sit at different readiness; that is shown with the existing neutral states and never explained in backend terms.
rules.note: Per-metric readiness differs within a role; a 200-day gap changes nothing; invalid metric rejected; unplayed role empty.

rules.rule: Rebuilds read stored data only and make no provider calls.
rules.note: Methodology, scope and role-correction rebuilds assert zero/unchanged provider_calls.

rules.rule: Every calculation is scoped to one bucket, one role, one metric, one metric version.
rules.note: Priors isolated by mode, role, metric, eligibility and analysis_version.

rules.rule: No composite: no role trend, player score, grade, rating, percentage, cross-role normalization, or all-role curve.
rules.note: Checked-in mobile OpenAPI has no score/grade/rating/percentile/rank/verdict/composite/win-rate fields; Progress/MatchDetail field sets asserted.

rules.rule: Trend requires a complete 10-point window; otherwise `Insufficient History`.
rules.note: 9 points → INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY; None point not counted.

rules.rule: `Insufficient History` is never styled or worded as decline; `Stable` is never worded as failure.
rules.note: Styling/wording of neutral trend states; backend emits distinct enums.

rules.rule: Baseline is the previous-20 median after a 5-prior gate; the current match never enters its own baseline.
rules.note: 5-prior gate, last-20 median, current/same-time match excluded from own baseline.

rules.rule: N/A never becomes zero and never enters a baseline, trend or PB.
rules.note: None excluded from baseline, PB and trend count; missing ≠ zero at measurement.

rules.rule: Progress is never context-adjusted and never shows a matchup badge.
rules.note: ProgressView and point field sets asserted exactly; no matchup or adjustment fields.

rules.rule: Calendar filters never redefine canonical math.
rules.note: /progress has no calendar parameter; windows are client-side over canonical series.

rules.rule: No time decay, inactivity penalty, trend expiry, season reset, or Progress-owned retention cutoff.
rules.note: Per-metric readiness differs within a role; a 200-day gap changes nothing; invalid metric rejected; unplayed role empty.

rules.rule: PB uses the comparison value and all known eligible history; ties are not PBs.
rules.note: PB uses comparison value over all entitled history; earliest tie kept.

rules.rule: A role correction rebuilds only the affected same-bucket old/new-role closure.
rules.note: Unaffected-role and Turbo analyses keep pointers; later match untouched; no events.

rules.rule: One canonical methodology is displayed at a time; mixed timelines are never published.
rules.note: Baseline-version bump rebuilds once then no-ops; a failed replay rolls back to the previous coherent pointers.

rules.rule: Entitlement changes never masquerade as performance change.
rules.note: Scope reduction emits no performance event; trend direction after reduction needs the owner-approved calibration artifact.

rules.rule: Win/loss never appears as a progression signal.
rules.note: Checked-in mobile OpenAPI has no score/grade/rating/percentile/rank/verdict/composite/win-rate fields; Progress/MatchDetail field sets asserted.

rules.rule: A match still awaiting deep evidence contributes no observation, no baseline movement and no trend point.
rules.note: Pending match shows metrics [], no finalized_at, zero analyses; observations/baselines only at finalization.

rules.rule: A match finalized without deep evidence contributes its summary-class metrics and shows N/A — not zero — for the rest.
rules.note: REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE finalizes with summary metrics and reasoned N/A (raw None), not zero.

rules.rule: Two metrics in the same role at different readiness both render correctly, with no backend explanation shown.
rules.note: Per-metric readiness differs within a role; a 200-day gap changes nothing; invalid metric rejected; unplayed role empty.

rules.rule: A baseline-definition change recomputes history from stored data with zero provider calls.
rules.note: Baseline-version bump rebuilds once then no-ops; a failed replay rolls back to the previous coherent pointers.

rules.rule: Selecting a role and bucket shows only that track's metrics and series.
rules.note: Per-metric readiness differs within a role; a 200-day gap changes nothing; invalid metric rejected; unplayed role empty.

rules.rule: No surface element aggregates metrics into a role-level verdict.
rules.note: Checked-in mobile OpenAPI has no score/grade/rating/percentile/rank/verdict/composite/win-rate fields; Progress/MatchDetail field sets asserted.

rules.rule: A metric with fewer than 10 eligible trend points shows `Insufficient History`, styled neutrally.
rules.note: <10 points → INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY with null reason; neutral styling is client-side.

rules.rule: A lower-is-better metric moving down is `Improving`.
rules.note: carry.dead_time falling → IMPROVING (test-only calibration).

rules.rule: N/A points are visibly not zero, and are excluded from baseline and trend counts.
rules.note: N/A excluded from trend count and baseline; /progress omits null points; visual treatment client-side.

rules.rule: A calendar filter changes the view without changing any trend state or baseline.
rules.note: No server calendar filter; client windows canonical series.

rules.rule: A role never played in the selected bucket shows an unstarted state, not zeros.
rules.note: Per-metric readiness differs within a role; a 200-day gap changes nothing; invalid metric rejected; unplayed role empty.

rules.rule: Each PB shows its value, hero, date, role, mode and a route to its source match.
rules.note: Progress PB returns value, hero, achieved time and source match ref for the requested role and mode.

rules.rule: A raw value higher than the PB's raw value does not display as a PB when its comparison value is lower.
rules.note: Higher raw healing with a lower per-10 comparison value does not take the PB or celebrate.

rules.rule: After a correction, only the affected old/new-role series in that bucket change.
rules.note: Only old/new-role same-bucket series replay; other role and Turbo pointers unchanged.

rules.rule: After a migration, no series shows mixed methodology.
rules.note: All stale Standard analyses rebuilt, rerun finds none stale; priors never mix analysis versions.

rules.rule: An entitlement reduction that regresses a trend is not presented as decline.
rules.note: Trend states after an entitlement reduction depend on uncalibrated movement thresholds (open owner decision).

rules.rule: No matchup badge, adjusted expectation or hero/lane adjustment appears anywhere on this surface.
rules.note: Progress response omits matchup and adjustment content (exact field sets).

rules.rule: One active Steam ID per app account; one app account per Steam ID.
rules.note: DB uniqueness under concurrency, second link rejected, cross-account claim rejected, switch to owned target blocked.

rules.rule: No normal unlink action exists.
rules.note: No unlink route exists; checked-in OpenAPI snapshot pins the route set. No explicit negative assertion.

rules.rule: A successful switch starts a 90-day cooldown; failed attempts do not reset it.
rules.note: 90-day cooldown after success; failed attempt does not start it.

rules.rule: Switching is blocked during a non-terminal import or rebuild, and blocked when the target is owned by another account.
rules.note: Rebuild-only operation blocks switching; invalid target reported; cooldown/owned/import causes asserted.

rules.rule: No analytical state crosses a Steam switch, and old-profile state is never shown for the new identity.
rules.note: After switch, history, Profile and Progress for the new identity show no old-profile state.

rules.rule: Free and Pro share one ingestion pipeline and one match model; entitlement is applied above persisted analysis results.
rules.note: Acquisition/analysis modules never read scope; scope rebuild reuses identical analyses; entitlement applied at prior-selection/read.

rules.rule: Fresh-match ingestion is viable with zero paying users and never depends on conversion revenue.
rules.note: Fresh path proven entitlement-independent and runs end-to-end for Free users; cost/capacity viability with zero payers is operational, not tested.

rules.rule: Pro historical acquisition runs at the normal historical priority and never delays any user's fresh match.
rules.note: PRO_BACKFILL/HISTORICAL_BATCH claimed at P3; live match finalizes while import pending; P0 worker not starved by blocked P3 for another user.

rules.rule: Entitlement transitions rebuild from stored data; a full refetch happens only when retained coverage is genuinely incomplete.
rules.note: Scope rebuilds make zero provider calls; backfill fetches only unheld pre-link history; resubscription queues no second backfill.

rules.rule: Pro entitlement belongs to the app account; Pro-derived **history** is scoped to the Steam profile.
rules.note: Pro stays on the account; the new profile gets its own backfill; archived history stays profile-scoped.

rules.rule: Pro activation and deactivation are atomic; no partially rebuilt state is exposed.
rules.note: Scope stays (FREE,0) until rebuild publishes; activation waits for history; stale activation cannot publish.

rules.rule: Losing Steam data access never revokes Pro or wipes Pro history.
rules.note: Blocked access keeps PRO scope and profile; historical acquisition defers without provider calls.

rules.rule: Pro expiry generates no negative or downgrade celebration; scope change is never presented as performance change.
rules.note: After refund rebuild, NEW_PB/MATCH_READY event counts unchanged; only SCOPE_CHANGED emitted. Presentation framing is client.

rules.rule: Pro historical data is retained after expiry and reused on resubscription.
rules.note: After expiry, resubscription reactivates PRO with no new PRO_BACKFILL and unchanged provider-call count; analyses reused.

rules.rule: Pro is never framed as more accurate.
rules.note: Framing copy; identical methodology covered under #10.6.

rules.rule: Notification permission never gates processing, readiness or account state.
rules.note: READY events recorded with notifications disabled/revoked; only outbox suppressed. Pipeline tests run with notifications_enabled default false.

rules.rule: Account deletion is immediate, outranks background work, releases the Steam link, and cancels renewal without a prorated refund.
rules.note: Fence, removal and Steam release verified; subscription renewal handling at deletion is an open owner/legal decision.

rules.rule: Accounts are never automatically merged, by any path including recovery.
rules.note: Collision blocked, never merged; the recovery verification flow is an open owner decision.

rules.rule: Attaching a colliding auth identity is blocked and routed to recovery, never merged.
rules.note: IdentityCollision raised with recovery_path /account/recovery; owner's session untouched, no merge.

rules.rule: No standalone unlink action exists anywhere in the product.
rules.note: Backend exposes no unlink route (pinned OpenAPI). Client UI must also comply.

rules.rule: A switch attempt is blocked with a clear cause for each of: cooldown, non-terminal rebuild, target owned elsewhere, validation failure.
rules.note: Rebuild-only operation blocks switching; invalid target reported; cooldown/owned/import causes asserted.

rules.rule: A failed switch attempt leaves the cooldown timer unchanged.
rules.note: A rejected switch leaves preflight available; only success starts the cooldown.

rules.rule: After a successful switch, no PB, baseline, achievement, role history, match history, cursor, correction or notification state from the old profile is visible.
rules.note: Old matches, PBs and progress points are not visible after a successful switch.

rules.rule: A Pro user after a switch sees the new profile's Free/bootstrap state first, never the old profile's analytics.
rules.note: New profile starts Free and shows only its own (empty) state.

rules.rule: Data-access loss retains the link, retains Pro, blocks acquisition, and shows recovery guidance.
rules.note: Link and Pro retained, acquisition deferred, /recovery reports BLOCKED.

rules.rule: Recovery re-anchors to the original Steam-link date and records unrecoverable gaps.
rules.note: Recovery anchored to the original link date queues post-link matches; absent sources are recorded as gaps.

rules.rule: No code path acquires, enriches or measures a fresh match differently for a Free and a Pro user.
rules.note: Static scan: acquisition, enrichment and metric modules contain no scope/entitlement tokens; fresh finalizer path scope-free.

rules.rule: A Pro historical import never delays a freshly completed match, for that user or any other.
rules.note: Live match READY while import pending; P0 other-user job completes while P3 blocked; Pro import runs at P3.

rules.rule: Pro activation, expiry and resubscription rebuild from stored data without a provider refetch when coverage is complete.
rules.note: Activation, refund/expiry and resubscription rebuilds leave provider_calls unchanged.

rules.rule: Pro cannot be purchased without a linked Steam ID.
rules.note: submit_transaction raises 'linked Steam' without an active profile.

rules.rule: Pro activation and expiry switch all dependent state together, with no mixed intermediate visible.
rules.note: Scope, revision, baselines and PB flip together at publish; FREE,0 visible until then; expiry flips back atomically.

rules.rule: Pro expiry that changes a PB presents it as entitlement scope, not as a lost record.
rules.note: Expiry reverts the PB to the Free-scope best with a SCOPE_CHANGED event and no loss/negative event.

rules.rule: Resubscription reuses retained history without a full refetch when coverage is complete.
rules.note: Renewal after expiry queues no second PRO_BACKFILL; provider calls unchanged; PRO revision 3 published.

rules.rule: Declining notifications changes nothing about tracking or readiness.
rules.note: Disabled/revoked permission suppresses only the outbox; READY events unaffected.

rules.rule: Deletion is available during any running job, takes effect immediately, and prevents late results from restoring state.
